Class AotCacheReport

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.runner.build.AotCacheReport
@Internal public final class AotCacheReport extends Object
What the verification gate found, written as aot-report.json next to the cache.

Internal to Runner's interim build plugins, which log its summary(): it may change in any release. It is a final class rather than a record so that the summary is all that is public.

Since:
